reports.headline: Revenue $640 million, up 8% year over year as reported. GAAP EPS $0.12.

quotes.speaker: Rita Chen
quotes.title: Chief Executive Officer
quotes.text: We are raising the full-year outlook because enterprise renewals closed ahead of plan, and we expect that to hold into the fourth quarter.

reports.so_what: Against your focus: the raise is attributed to enterprise renewals closing early, by the CEO's own account.

report_markdown:
**Globex raised full-year revenue guidance to $2.55 to $2.65 billion from $2.5 to $2.6 billion.** Q3 FY2026 revenue was $640 million, up 8% year over year; GAAP EPS $0.12. Consensus was not verified.

CEO Rita Chen: "We are raising the full-year outlook because enterprise renewals closed ahead of plan, and we expect that to hold into the fourth quarter." Analyst questions covered renewal pricing, the fourth-quarter outlook and headcount.
